unit.why: A teaching on the midnight vigil (chatzot): the author's father warns against staying awake until after midnight, citing R. Elimelech's habit of sleeping until midnight and the Or ha-Hayyim's description of his grandfather's nightly lament and study; these are habitual practices, not narrated events.
